name: HandBrake 1.11 Video Transcoder in Your Browser
description: HandBrake GUI in a browser tab with login, watch folder and file manager.

PORT.description: Web GUI port (public domain target and healthcheck).

WEB_AUTHENTICATION_USERNAME.description: Login user name for the web GUI (letters, digits, . _ @ -).

WEB_AUTHENTICATION_PASSWORD.description: Login password, generated at deploy. 12-256 characters without spaces; anything else locks the login until fixed.

AUTOMATED_CONVERSION.description: 1 = convert every video dropped into /config/watch automatically, 0 = off.

AUTOMATED_CONVERSION_PRESET.description: HandBrake preset for automatic conversion, as Category/Preset Name.

AUTOMATED_CONVERSION_FORMAT.description: Container of automatically converted files (mp4 or mkv).

AUTOMATED_CONVERSION_KEEP_SOURCE.description: 1 = keep the source in /config/watch after conversion, 0 = delete it.

HANDBRAKE_GUI_QUEUE_STARTUP_ACTION.description: What the GUI does with a saved queue at start: PROCESS, CLEAR or NONE.

DISPLAY_WIDTH.description: Width of the virtual screen in pixels.

DISPLAY_HEIGHT.description: Height of the virtual screen in pixels.
